blocks.rules:
- browser_exec: calls are timing out; reduce batch size or scope and set explicit timeouts.
- memory: writes exceed the memory budget; combine remove or shorten operations with the add in one batch call.
- patch: old_string must match the file as it is now; after any successful edit, re-read the target lines and copy old_string verbatim from that fresh read, including indentation.
- read_file: calls are being blocked by a policy guard; read the block reason and change the call content instead of resending it.
- read_file: file-not-found errors recur; confirm exact paths with search_files(target='files') before reading.
- search_files: content patterns are Rust regex; escape metacharacters such as ( ) [ ] { } * + ? or search filenames with target='files' and a glob.
- search_files: permission-denied paths recur; scope searches to readable project subdirectories instead of broad roots.
- search_files: the search path does not exist; confirm the directory before searching.
- session_search: do not scroll anchors from the current session lineage; that content is already in context.
- skill_manage: copy old_string verbatim from a skill_view taken after your last edit to that skill; never quote it from memory or from an earlier view.
- skill_view: calls are being blocked by a policy guard; read the block reason and change the call content instead of resending it.
- terminal: 'command not found' (exit 127) recurs; confirm the binary is on PATH (command -v NAME) before invoking it.
- terminal: HTTP errors recur; verify URLs and fall back to browser_exec for bot-walled pages.
- terminal: never end a foreground command with '&'; use background=True (with notify) for long-running processes.
- terminal: rate limits are being hit; back off, reduce batch size, and avoid parallel bursts.
- tool_call: calls are being blocked by a policy guard; read the block reason and change the call content instead of resending it.
- write_file: overwriting an existing file requires a full read_file of it in this task first; use patch for targeted edits.

decision_rule.b_r3: gate fails when solve_rate(rules) - solve_rate(control) < -5.0 pp; passes otherwise. If a prior arm is present it is reported alongside, same margin, rules vs prior.
decision_rule.b_r4: content_effect when solve_rate(rules) - solve_rate(placebo) >= +5.0 pp; harm when <= -5.0 pp; null otherwise. placebo is density-matched to the rule block by token count.

primary_metric: benign solve rate per arm on the same seeded tasks; paired per task
